shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/pillar carved in relief on its face
registers or horizontal bands dividing the surface
repeated row of small motifs forming a band
dense low-relief covering the whole surface
justification: Both are upright relief-carved slabs whose surfaces are filled with figural motifs organized loosely into horizontal registers, and both include animals in profile and rows of repeated small elements. But A depicts a single frontal human figure in elaborate costume and headdress, its face and hands central, surrounded by scroll-like ornament, whereas B shows no human figure at all: only quadrupeds, a long-necked bird and a snake-like form arranged as separate isolated animals above a plain shaft, with far more schematic, sparse and rounded modelling.
